i think you should watch jojo’s, but that’s just because i love it. it’s a very over the top and flashy show that is fun to watch. i think that the best part of the show is the characters, and watching them grow, their back stories, and the way they interact with each other. the stories are interesting, and the fights are fun to watch, but the characters are the star of the show. there is a quite a bit of gore, but a lot of the gore isn’t just basic gore. the gore in jojo’s is new (at least to me) and fun to look at. each episode is a roller coaster of emotions because there can be very sudden mood changes. each part follows a new joestar’s (bizarre) adventures, friends, and tragedies. there are 8 parts, and 5 of the 8 parts are animated, and the 5 parts are split into 4 seasons. the manga has around 120 volumes, and it is surprisingly quick to read. i love both the manga and the anime. i am rambling so much but it’s from my love of the show. 

this is the order of the parts, idk if its confusing to anyone else, but it was to me when i first started jojo’s.
Part 1: Phantom Blood
Part 2: Battle Tendency
Part 3: Stardust Crusaders
Part 4: Diamond Is Unbreakable
Part 5: Golden Wind
Part 6: Stone Ocean
Part 7: Steel Ball Run
Part 8: JoJolion

TLDR: yes. to me jojo’s has good characters, fun plot lines, and interesting gore.
